description: Thresholds for the Pharos risk-adjusted treasury gate

deny_on_active_depeg.description: Deny while Pharos reports a confirmed active depeg incident for the asset.

max_peg_deviation_bps.description: Maximum tolerated absolute deviation from the peg target, in basis points. Catches an asset drifting off peg before an incident is formally declared.

max_stress_score.description: Maximum tolerated Pharos stress score (0-100). Stress is the earlier and broader signal, rising before a full depeg.

require_redemption.description: When true, the asset must have a working direct redemption route. When false, redemption is only checked if a route is reported.

approved_redemption_route_families.description: Pharos redemption route families the curator will accept (e.g. 'issuer-direct', 'authorised-participant'). An asset redeeming through anything else denies.

approved_access_models.description: Pharos redemption access models the curator will accept (e.g. 'permissionless', 'kyc-gated'). Governs WHO may redeem, not how.

min_exit_capacity_multiple.description: Minimum ratio of sellable-without-excess-slippage capacity to the resulting position. 3 requires the treasury be able to exit three times the position it is taking on.

min_liquidity_score.description: Minimum Pharos DEX liquidity score (0-100), summarising depth and quality of available exit liquidity.

max_data_age_seconds.description: Maximum tolerated age of the Pharos observation. Null ages from the oracle fail-soft and do not trigger this rule.
